special_rules: Filer vs Non-filer distinction: non-filers face higher withholding rates
Stocks held < 1 year: 15% CGT for filers
Dividend income: 15% WHT (final tax for filers)
Futures & options: taxed as business income (normal tax rates)
NCCPL collects CGT at source from PSX transactions
stock.filing_requirement: Income Tax Return with FBR (IRIS portal)

crypto.short_term_rate_pct: Not specifically regulated (income tax rates may apply)
special_rules: Pakistan does not have specific cryptocurrency tax legislation as of 2026
SBP (State Bank of Pakistan) and SECP have not formally recognised crypto as legal tender
Crypto gains may be treated as 'income from other sources' under Income Tax Ordinance 2001
Roshan Digital Account (RDA): foreign Pakistanis can invest in government securities — withholding exempt
Proposed Virtual Asset Service Provider (VASP) framework under SECP — watch for updates
Risk of all crypto income being taxed at income slab rates (up to 35%)
crypto.filing_requirement: Consult FBR guidance — evolving area; declare under 'other income' if earning

real_estate.long_term_rate_pct: 5% (3-4 years) / 0% (>4 years, for filers on open plots)
special_rules: CGT rates decrease with holding period: 15% (< 1 year) → 10% (1-2 years) → 7.5% (2-3 years) → 5% (3-4 years) → 0% (> 4 years for plots)
Constructed property different rates from open plots
FBR valuation tables vs. DC rates: whichever is higher applies for stamp duty
Section 7E: deemed income tax on immovable property (1% of FBR value annually for filers)
Non-filer penalty: 3% advance WHT on purchase price (instead of 1% for filers)
Benami transactions: banned under Benami Transactions (Prohibition) Act 2017
real_estate.filing_requirement: CGT return with FBR; withholding at registration by Registrar

notes: Pakistan has a complex dual-rate system for filers vs non-filers. Being on the Active Taxpayer List (ATL) significantly reduces your tax burden. Corporate tax: 29% (general), 20% (small companies). Super Tax applies above PKR 150m income.
